'''Carlon Belcelona''' is a [[Tairen]] noble who is part of [[Cha Faile]].

== Appearance ==
He has a long nose and a narrow chin.

== Activities ==
A member of [[Cha Faile]]. He accompanies [[Faile Bashere]] to [[Ghealdan]]. When Faile is captured by the [[Shaido]] he is forced to obey [[Perrin Aybara]].

He is part of Perrin's group that goes to the town of [[Almizar]] to pick up some [[Forkroot]].
